title: Mushroom sauce
html:
A quick sauce with mushrooms, red wine, and crème fraîche.

Ingredients

  • 250 g mushrooms
  • 1 dl red wine
  • ½ dl crème fraîche
  • Salt and pepper
  • 15 g butter
